name: Lumateperone
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Multiple pathways contribute: CYP3A4/CYP2C8/CYP1A2 oxidation, UGT glucuronidation and aldo-keto reductases. Numerous metabolites form; elimination is through urine and feces, with little unchanged drug in urine.
